description: Creates a personalized real-time AI voice roleplay simulation on Atlas Primer from a natural-language scenario description. Returns a direct, clickable simulation URL requiring no API keys or pre-registration.

challenge_keywords.description: 3 to 4 comma-separated behavioral resistance traits (e.g., "skeptical, defensive, budget-constrained").

character_name.description: Counterpart name and title (e.g., "Elena Rostova, VP of Procurement").

character_role.description: Counterpart functional role or authority level.

failure_criteria.description: Single sentence defining what triggers conversation failure.

language.description: ISO-639-1 language code such as "en", "is", "es", or "ja" (default: "en").

max_duration_minutes.description: Maximum duration in minutes between 3 and 30 (default: 10).

prompt.description: Full 1-paragraph scenario description defining who the user is, who the counterpart is, the core conflict or disagreement, and the stakes.

success_criteria.description: Single unambiguous sentence defining measurable conversation success.

user_role.description: Learner role and perspective (e.g., "Senior Account Executive").

name: create_roleplay_simulation

query_url.description: Fallback clickable simulation URL using plain query parameters (?prompt=...).

url.description: Primary clickable simulation URL using Base64URL fragment (#d=...).

title: Create Voice Roleplay Simulation
